WHO IS ASHIK?

Who is Ashik?

I’m a graphic designer focused on turning ideas into clear, premium and engaging visual communication. With 11+ years of experience across GCC markets, I create strong visual solutions for brands, retail and promotional campaigns. My work spans branding, packaging, advertising, social media, catalogues, print and digital design, with a focus on clean layouts, impactful storytelling and professional brand presentation.
